en: The front of the postcard features a black-and-white photograph of a rural landscape with a large truss bridge stretching over a river. There are hills covered with trees in the background, some clearings, and a steamboat or industrial building emitting smoke on the riverbank. The printed text on the image reads 'Bergeforsen.' and 'Indalselfven.' There is also handwritten Swedish text on the image. The reverse side shows an old-fashioned Swedish address format and a recipient's details written in cursive.
